Lord, what is man, poor feeble man
Lord, what is man, poor feeble man,
Born of the earth at first!
His life a shadow, light and vain,
Watts made this hymn from Psalm 144:3–6, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

3O LORD, what is man, that You regard him, the son of man that You think of him? 4Man is like a breath; his days are like a passing shadow. 5Part Your heavens, O LORD, and come down; touch the mountains, that they may smoke. 6Flash forth Your lightning and scatter them; shoot Your arrows and rout them. PSALM 144:3–6 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 144
